title: Lesson 25 - Did You Get My Message?

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Hi, Daniel. Did you get my message about the orientation guide?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Yes, I saw the message this morning, but I haven't received the attachment yet.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: That's odd. I've already sent it twice.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: The message arrived, but there wasn't a file attached. Could you check the version in your sent folder?

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: You're right. I attached the meeting notes, not the guide. I've just sent the correct file separately.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: It hasn't appeared yet. I'll refresh my inbox and check my spam folder.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Okay, it's here now: “Orientation Guide, version three.”

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Great. Can you confirm you received all twelve pages?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Yes, twelve pages. I've already opened it, and the comments are visible.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Does page four show two comment boxes beside the welcome paragraph?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Yes, both boxes are there, and I can read the full notes.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Perfect. Could you update the welcome section by three this afternoon?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Yes. I'll send it again as both a document and a PDF, so you can compare them.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Thanks. If I haven't replied by four, please follow up. I may be in a meeting.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Will do. I'll put “Updated welcome section” in the subject line.
